what: Bootstrap loses the only probe result available to the absorbed degraded gate
scenario_or_breakage: The plan removes CODEX_PRESENT and CURSOR_PRESENT from durable env and routing facts, but bootstrap resume and the absorbed tail currently read those values from session-env or the filtered envelope. Continue or dirty-tree resume can see empty presence, misclassify as both down, or fail to enforce stale-sentinel both-down hard-fail.
suggested_fix: Keep probe presence as private in-memory data through the degraded gate, or rerun check_reviewers for bootstrap initial and resume before the gate. Do not persist it to session-env or bootstrap-routing.

what: /review and /research still derive launch eligibility from Step 0 probe health
scenario_or_breakage: If a binary exists but the Step 0 probe is false and the operator continues, /review passes false to review core and /research skips Codex or Cursor lanes. That violates the required caller-site binary-only routing and silently shrinks panels.
suggested_fix: Add explicit /review and /research prompt updates: parse CODEX_BINARY_FOUND and CURSOR_BINARY_FOUND, bind launch eligibility from binary presence or fresh executable checks, and reserve CODEX_PRESENT and CURSOR_PRESENT only for degraded-gate messaging.

what: /design secondary vendor launchers remain health-gated after health globals are removed
scenario_or_breakage: With CODEX_PRESENT removed from source-env, the Codex drafter, plan revise/autofix waterfall, and decompose panel/aggregator can skip external vendors even when binaries are installed. Stale false probe state can still suppress calls.
suggested_fix: Add these call sites to the plan and pass or compute CODEX_BINARY_FOUND and CURSOR_BINARY_FOUND for launch eligibility. Update plan_quality and decompose to gate on binary presence or shutil.which, not probe presence.
